_comment: Egress schedules for providers with no machine-readable pricing endpoint.
AWS, Azure and OCI are NOT here — they are collected live (pipeline/collectors/egress.mjs).
'source_verified_at' is set only when a human has read the figure off the
provider's own page on that date. Entries without it are badged 'unverified'.
'bundled_with_compute: true' means the real allowance is per-plan on the compute
record (included_egress_gb) and these tiers price the OVERAGE only.
'regions' overrides any top-level field for one canonical region.

notes: Premium network tier (the default). Standard tier is cheaper but routes over the public internet sooner.
Only the first 1 GiB/month is free — GCP's larger always-free allowances do not apply to Premium Tier egress.
Priced by DESTINATION continent, not source region; these figures assume traffic stays on the same continent as the instance.
GCP bills per GiB where most providers bill per GB, so these rates are ~7% higher than they look against a GB-priced competitor.
Top tier to Europe is $0.085/GiB, against $0.08 to North America.
Destination Asia (excl. Korea): top tier $0.085/GiB, same-continent assumption as elsewhere.
UNVERIFIED RATE. Hetzner's FAQ confirms only outgoing traffic is billed, in 100 MB blocks, above a per-plan allowance — it does not publish the per-TB rate, and the pricing tables render client-side.
The figure here (~EUR 1.00/TB) is carried over pending confirmation from the Cloud API's traffic_price_per_tb, which needs an account token.
Included traffic differs by network zone (eu-central, us-east, us-west, ap-southeast); not yet modelled per zone.
Singapore (sin) actually bills ~USD 8.30/TB overage with far smaller bundles — the live collector captures this; this curated fallback does not.
Droplet overage is $0.01 per GiB; inbound is free.
Allowances pool cumulatively across all Droplets at the team level, so a single-instance comparison understates the allowance a real account gets.
App Platform overage is $0.02/GiB and Spaces $0.01/GiB — neither is indexed here.
Overage is $0.005/GB ($5/TB) in all core data centres, including both regions indexed here.
A few regions cost more — Jakarta $0.015/GB, Sao Paulo $0.007/GB.
Allowances pool across all Linodes on the account.
Vultr: "We charge $0.01 per GB for bandwidth used in excess of your quota."
Allowance is per instance and does not pool across the account.
R2 charges zero egress on every storage class — unlimited, not an allowance. The structural outlier.
Storage and Class A/B operations are still billed, and Infrequent Access adds a $0.01/GB retrieval fee.
Object storage only; there is no Cloudflare VM for this to attach to.
Free egress up to 3x average monthly stored bytes, then $0.01/GB.
That allowance scales with storage, so it cannot be modelled as a flat free tier — the columns here assume no allowance and therefore OVERSTATE cost for most workloads.
Free entirely via many CDN and compute partners, including Cloudflare.
